variables.name: Lower-troposphere temperature
variables.definition: Air temperature at 850 hPa, roughly 1.5 km above sea level.

variables.name: Mid-troposphere temperature
variables.definition: Air temperature at 500 hPa, roughly 5.5 km above sea level.

variables.name: Upper-troposphere temperature
variables.definition: Air temperature at 250 hPa, roughly 10 km above sea level.

variables.name: Total column ozone
variables.definition: The amount of ozone in a column of air from the ground to the top of the atmosphere.

variables.name: Total water vapor
variables.definition: The mass of water vapor above each square meter of ground.

variables.name: Lower-troposphere temperature (AIRS)
variables.definition: Aqua satellite estimates of air temperature near 1.5 km above sea level during afternoon overpasses.

variables.name: Mid-troposphere temperature (AIRS)
variables.definition: Aqua satellite estimates of air temperature near 5.5 km above sea level during afternoon overpasses.

variables.name: Total column ozone (AIRS)
variables.definition: Aqua satellite estimates of the ozone in a column of air during afternoon overpasses.

variables.name: Total water vapor (AIRS)
variables.definition: Aqua satellite estimates of the mass of water vapor above each square meter during afternoon overpasses.

variables.name: Total runoff
variables.definition: Water leaving the land through surface flow and underground drainage each day.

variables.name: Evapotranspiration
variables.definition: Water moving from the land and plants into the air each day.

variables.name: Topsoil water
variables.definition: The mass of water in the top ten centimeters of soil beneath each square meter of land.
